title: Azolla Mechanistic Model V2.1: Identifiability-First Mechanistic Framework for Active Azolla Biofilters
description: Reproducible computational archive supporting the manuscript 'An Identifiability-First Mechanistic Framework for Active Azolla Biofilters: Coupling Physiology, Mass Transfer and Model-Form Uncertainty'. The repository contains the mechanistic modelling workflow, converged Sobol sensitivity analysis to N=2048 with bootstrap confidence intervals, practical-identifiability diagnostics, and machine-readable results. The model is literature-constrained and intended for screening and measurement prioritization; it does not claim experimental validation of a fabricated Azolla device.
